summary.en-US: Whole-phone tunnel for your Mozilla VPN / Firefox Private Network plan

description.en-US:
FPN Tunnel is an unofficial, open-source client that turns a Mozilla VPN /
Firefox Private Network subscription into a whole-device Android tunnel.

Sign in with your own Firefox account inside the app, pick an exit country
(or let Auto race them and pick a healthy one), and the whole phone routes
through Mozilla's MASQUE proxies. Built-in connection diagnostics ("Doctor")
detect sick gateways and fail over across countries automatically.

* No root, no Termux, no companion app — a single APK
* Native in-app Firefox account sign-in (no browser needed)
* Multiple Mozilla accounts with one-tap switching
* Tuned for filtered networks: DNS-over-HTTPS bootstrap, CONNECT-health
  probing, cross-country failover
* No ads, no analytics, no third-party trackers; anonymous error reporting
  is off unless you opt in

A small number of exit countries currently work without a subscription;
the full country set requires a paid Mozilla VPN / Firefox Private Network
subscription. Not affiliated with Mozilla.

Note: builds from this repo are signed with the developer's key — the same
key as the GitHub release APKs, so updates work across both. They are NOT
interchangeable with the future official F-Droid build (signed by F-Droid).
